```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, dpi=5000, cache=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="85%", fig.height=6.5, fig.width=6, fig.cap= ""}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(giscoR)
library(ggtext)


#--------------------------------------------------
# 0. Load data
#--------------------------------------------------

df     <- readRDS("../Data/filtered_interaction_data.rds")
lanuza <- readRDS("../Data/raw_interaction_data.rds")

#--------------------------------------------------
# 1. Get Study IDs and coordinates
#--------------------------------------------------

id <- df %>%
  separate(id, into = c("Study_id", "Location", "Date"), sep = "//") %>%
  distinct(Study_id) %>%
  pull()

coordinates_sf = lanuza %>%
  filter(Study_id %in% id) %>%
  select(Study_id, Latitude, Longitude) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(Study_id) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(3035)

#--------------------------------------------------
# 2. Pollinator richness (number of pollinators per study)
#--------------------------------------------------

pollinator_richness <- df %>%
  separate(id, into = c("Study_id", "Location", "Date"), sep = "//") %>%
  group_by(Study_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pollinators = n_distinct(pollinator),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#--------------------------------------------------
# 3. Study-level Apis vs Other interactions
#--------------------------------------------------

apis_wide <- df %>%
  separate(id, into = c("Study_id", "Location", "Date"), sep = "//") %>%
  mutate(
    is_apis = if_else(
      grepl("Apis", pollinator, ignore.case = TRUE),
      "Apis",
      "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Study_id, is_apis) %>%
  summarise(
    n_interactions = sum(interaction, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = is_apis,
    values_from = n_interactions,
    values_fill = 0
  )

#--------------------------------------------------
# 4. Combine coordinates, interactions, and richness
#--------------------------------------------------

pie_data <- coordinates_sf %>%
  left_join(apis_wide, by = "Study_id") %>%
  left_join(pollinator_richness, by = "Study_id") %>%
  mutate(
    x = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
    y = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2],
    total_inter     = Apis + Other,
    prop_apis_study = if_else(total_inter > 0, Apis / total_inter, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# Convert back to sf for spatial operations
pie_sf <- st_as_sf(
  pie_data,
  coords = c("x", "y"),
  crs    = 3035,
  remove = FALSE
)

#--------------------------------------------------
# 5. Countries layer (for reference only)
#--------------------------------------------------

cntries <- gisco_get_countries(region = "Europe", year = "2016") %>%
  st_transform(3035)

#--------------------------------------------------
# 6. Build FULL rectangular grid over Europe extent
#    (NOT clipped by borders)
#--------------------------------------------------

bbox_grid <- st_bbox(c(
  xmin = 2200000,
  xmax = 7150000,
  ymin = 1380000,
  ymax = 5500000
), crs = st_crs(3035))

grid_poly <- st_make_grid(
  st_as_sfc(bbox_grid),
  cellsize = 100000,   # 100 km grid
  square   = TRUE
)

grid_sf <- st_sf(
  grid_id  = seq_along(grid_poly),
  geometry = grid_poly
)

#--------------------------------------------------
# 7. Assign studies to grid cells & aggregate
#    (weight by number of pollinators per study)
#--------------------------------------------------

# Join each point to the grid cell it falls in
join <- st_join(pie_sf, grid_sf, join = st_within)

# Weighted aggregation per grid cell
grid_agg <- join %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(grid_id) %>%
  summarise(
    prop_apis = if (all(is.na(prop_apis_study)) || all(is.na(n_pollinators))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      weighted.mean(prop_apis_study, w = n_pollinators, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    n_studies    = n(),
    total_weight = sum(n_pollinators, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Attach aggregated values back to all grid cells
grid_full <- grid_sf %>%
  left_join(grid_agg, by = "grid_id") %>%
  mutate(
    prop_apis_perc = prop_apis * 100   # convert to percentage for plotting
  )

#--------------------------------------------------
# 8. Get centroids for symbol plotting
#--------------------------------------------------

grid_centroids <- st_centroid(grid_full)

grid_centroids_df <- grid_centroids %>%
  mutate(
    cx = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
    cy = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

#--------------------------------------------------
# 9. Plot: background grid + size-varying squares
#--------------------------------------------------
# 8b. Breaks for legends

size_limits <- range(grid_centroids_df$total_weight, na.rm = TRUE)
size_breaks <- pretty(size_limits, n = 4)

ggplot() +
  # Country polygons as reference
  geom_sf(
    data  = cntries,
    fill  = "grey85",
    color = "black",
    size  = 0.1
  ) +
  # Light background grid (all same size, low alpha)
  geom_sf(
    data  = grid_full,
    fill  = NA,
    color = "grey90",
    size  = 0.1
  ) +
  # Squares at centroids: size = total pollinator richness per cell,
  # fill = weighted proportion of Apis interactions
  geom_point(
    data = grid_centroids_df,
    aes(
      x    = cx,
      y    = cy,
      size = total_weight,
      fill = prop_apis_perc
    ),
    shape  = 22,  # filled square
    color  = "black",
    stroke = 0.1
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim   = c(2200000, 7150000),
    ylim   = c(1380000, 5500000),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option   = "C",
    na.value = NA,
    name     = "Honeybee interactions (%)",
    breaks   = c(0,20,40,60),
    labels   = c(0,20,40,60),
    limits   = c(0, 70), 
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Total pollinator\nrichness",
    range = c(1, 6.5)  # tweak as needed
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_colorbar(order = 1),
    size = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
    panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 1),
    legend.position  = "right",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    axis.text  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.title    = element_markdown(size = 10),
    plot.margin      = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5)) +
  xlab(NULL) +
  ylab(NULL)


```
